checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Four separate square slides with exact names in order
must.why: Four square slides in the right order, but slide 4 text reads 'Peace d lly' instead of 'Peace lily'.

must.item: Plants distinguishable (split monstera, upright snake plant, trailing pothos, peace lily with white spathe)
must.why: Monstera has split leaves, the snake plant has upright striped leaves, and pothos trails. The peace lily has a small, weak spathe but is recognisable.

must.item: Same sage-green and cream linocut treatment
must.why: All four share the same palette and print look. Pothos is a slightly more saturated green.

must.item: Border, lettering, paper texture, pot consistent
must.why: Same double border, serif lettering, paper and pot. Minor border and tint variations.

must.item: Only plant and name change; aligned; names readable
must.why: Layout is aligned, but the Peace lily name is garbled and unreadable as written.

faults.what: Slide 4 name is garbled: 'Peace d lly' instead of 'Peace lily'.
Peace lily spathe is tiny and not a clear white spathe; the plant reads as generic leaves.
Pothos slide has a slightly more saturated green and a slightly heavier border than the others.

summary: The four slides are consistent and attractive, but the Peace lily label is garbled as 'Peace d lly', so that slide needs a redo.
